Event overview

Beyond the Front Door: Exploring the Home of the RCGP

London GP International Medical Graduate (IMG) Registrar opportunity




Tuesday 12 January 2027 

Tour 16:00 to 17:00

Refreshments and networking 17:-18:00




Wednesday 10 February 2027 

Tour 17:00 to 18:00

Refreshments and networking 18:00 to 19:00




South London Faculty warmly invites you to join us for a FREE guided tour of the headquarters at 30 Euston Square, followed by an opportunity to socialise over refreshments.




This exclusive tour offers access to spaces, exhibitions and memorabilia that are not usually open to the public. Discover the fascinating history of both the College and the NHS, while exploring the remarkable architecture of the building that has served as the College's home for many years.

Museum and heritage




Places are strictly limited




Cost 

Members Free*




*A refundable deposit of £10 will be taken at the time of booking and will only be kept in the case of non-attendance.
